newsitem.title: GERMANY: Ex-Munich air cargo exports up 24pct in October 96.
newsitem.headline: Ex-Munich air cargo exports up 24pct in October 96.

text.p: Air cargo exports from Munich airport soared more than 24 percent in October, figures from airport authority Flughafen Muenchen GmbH (FMG) showed.
Exports rose by 24.4 percent last month after showing single-figure growth in August and September, the monthly FMG traffic report said.
The first ten months showed a 7.8 percent rise in exports, the report added.
Imports continued their strong growth with a 31.2 percent rise in October after high double-figure growth over the previous two months.
There has been a 21.9 percent rise in imports from January-October, the report said.
Cargo volumes at Munich are likely to grow strongly this autumn with the October 29 start of a Federal Express freighter service five times a week to Paris, observers said.
Inter-continental cargo capacity has been expanded with a second weekly China Eastern flight to Beijing and Shanghai, a separate FMG statement said.
Additional capacity to south-east Asia will be offered by a twice-weekly Thai Airways flight via Istanbul to Bangkok from December 12.
Deutsche Lufthansa AG has added a third weekly flight to Thailand with an Airbus A340, the statement added. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
